Corpus sentences naming ABC-Bench, plus the cited release-decision sentences (system-card corpus docs.sqlite, document slug in brackets):
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] SecureBio, a nonprofit research organization focused on catastrophic biological risk, evaluated two pre-release checkpoints of GPT-5.6 Sol and a railfree version of GPT-5.6 Sol. For the assessment, system-level biological risk content filters were disabled.
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] The railfree checkpoint also set a new high on ABC-Bench’s Advanced Screening Evasion and reliably identified a known but practically inconve-nient method for evading a commercial nucleic-acid screening algorithm.
[openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card] Overall, SecureBio concluded that GPT-5.6 could provide substantial uplift to some actors, including wet-lab experts with limited computational experience, but with important limita-tions in judgment, communication, and risk-sensitive decision-making.
